Confirmatory comparative models still require dated within-clade trees or a justified branch-length strategy.

Architecture-balanced v2 simulation shows the 79-taxon design is viable in principle but not yet empirically adequate: current recovery is ≈0.768 additive, 0.414 weakest-link, 0.448 threshold; complete random-configuration 79 reaches ≈1.000/0.850/0.748, while an oracle configuration-diverse upper bound reaches ≈1.000/1.000/0.915. Unblock only after A–F deep coding/backfill, O1–O7 outcome coding, H/J improvement, empirical configuration audit, and rerun on observed values/missingness. Dynamic interaction/feedback requires a separately specified temporal/network model.

Eleven pairwise dated contradictions passed interval-direction audit. Expand source coverage and uncertainty model before confirmatory temporal inference.
